title: CSCI 559 — Seminar in Systems
subject: Computer Systems
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core abstraction layers that separate user applications from hardware execution.
Identify the fundamental components of a Unix-like kernel that manage system resources.
Recognize how abstraction enables modular design and security isolation in operating systems.
